title: design-microbench input
description: A prediction-error report: the experiments that missed, the one mechanism suspected, and the parameter a measurement would produce. A report with no miss above the hole threshold is refused, because a correct model needs no new measurement.

mechanism.description: The one mechanism the microbenchmark isolates, stated as a claim about the device.

metric.description: Canonical metric the mechanism is visible in. Used to find the existing suite item that already observes it.

parameter.description: The parameter the measurement produces, e.g. 'sectors per request versus stride curve'.

used_by.description: What consumes the parameter; a measurement nothing consumes is not worth a suite slot.

extend_suite_item.description: Existing suite item to extend. Inferred from the metric when omitted.

new_item.description: True to propose a new suite item; refused when an existing item already observes the metric.
